reviews.body:
Nice one, an empty `--explain` with no hint is a confusing thing to debug, and pulling the check into `checkCompletionContent` keeps the five backends consistent with `openai.go`. The extra `len(resp.Choices) == 0` guard in `bedrockmantle.go` also closes an index-out-of-range panic that was there before.

I read the full diff and the table test, and build and the Go tests are green at `8218530`. One thing left: the `validate` check fails because this repo only allows the `deps` scope in titles. Renaming to `fix: reject empty completions from azureopenai, groq, litellm, gpt2giga and bedrockmantle` should turn it green.

Small heads-up: #1901 also touches `GetCompletion` in `azureopenai.go`, so whichever lands second may need a quick rebase.

Thanks for the rename. Delta checked: `6c47319` has the same tree as `8218530` (only the commit message changed), and `validate`, build and tests are all green now.

Heads-up still stands that #1901 touches `GetCompletion` in `azureopenai.go`, so whichever lands second may need a rebase. Good to merge.
